summary: Multi-author blog platform with shareable post links. Unauthenticated visitors see a preview/teaser before being prompted to log in or create an Internet Identity. Admin panel and image upload features previously implemented.
architectural_notes: Multi-author platform: any logged-in user can create blog posts
Shareable blog post links use Internet Identity for authentication gate

existing_features.title: Allow any authenticated user to create blog posts (multi-author platform). Remove any restriction that limits post creation to admins/owners only. The 'Create Post' page and navigation link must be accessible to all logged-in users.
Add a 'Copy shareable link' button to each blog post detail page and post card. The shareable link must be a direct URL to that specific post (e.g., /#/post/{postId}).

When an unauthenticated visitor opens a shared post link, show a preview/teaser of the post (title, author, date, and the first ~150 words or 3 sentences of content, plus the first image if available) followed by a login gate prompt. The full post content must be hidden behind the gate. The login gate must provide a button to log in via Internet Identity and a link to create a new Internet Identity.

new_feature_requests.summary: Shareable link for each blog post with login gate - unauthenticated visitors see a preview/teaser then prompted to log in or create an account

The PostDetailPage must support anonymous actor access so unauthenticated visitors can fetch the post data needed to render the preview/teaser. The backend getPost (or equivalent) function must be callable without authentication.
